caption:
A fallen place you're sure can't be rebuilt? He raises ruins with His own hand. (Amos 9:11 devotional)

The book that began as a curse ends as restoration — and it points to Christ. What you've written off as over is where He loves to begin.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What ruin in me have I quietly decided is beyond repair?
